ALGER, 27 juillet 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: ALGIERS, July 27, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The General Directorate of Taxes (DGI) yesterday launched an online payment service integrated into the “Jibayatic” portal, allowing Algerian taxpayers to pay their taxes from home. This system is part of a strategy of modernization and dematerialization of tax services.
La Direction générale des impôts (DGI) a: The General Directorate of Taxes (DGI) announced yesterday the deployment of an online payment service on the “Jibayatic” portal. From now on, taxpayers can pay their taxes by bank card or transfer, without going to the tax services. This launch marks a decisive step in the modernization of the tax administration.
Le portail « Jibayatic », contraction de: The “Jibayatic” portal, a contraction of jibaya (collection/collection) and the suffix tic (Information and Communication Technologies), now centralizes declarations and remote payments. This new tool aims to simplify the lives of citizens and strengthen the efficiency of public revenue collection.
Public cible et régimes fiscaux concerné: Target audience and tax regimes concerned
Le service s’adresse à tous les contribu: The service is aimed at all taxpayers, without exception of tax regime. It concerns individuals (employees, fixed-price traders) as well as businesses (SMEs, large companies) or self-employed professionals. Each taxpayer, whether subject to IRG, IBS or another regime, can now use this platform.
Le régime fiscal détermine les règles d’: The tax system determines the tax rules applicable to each taxpayer. This may be the flat rate, the simplified actual or the normal actual, depending on the activity, turnover or situation of the taxpayer.
La DGI propose plusieurs canaux de paiem: The DGI offers several payment channels adapted to user habits:
Ces opérations sont réalisables via cinq: These operations are carried out via five partner banking establishments: the National Bank of Algeria (BNA), the Crédit populaire d'Algérie (CPA), the Local Development Bank (BDL), the Bank of Agriculture and Rural Development (BADR) and the Bank of Algeria Abroad (BAE).
Accès au service et sécurité: Access to the service and security
Pour utiliser « Jibayatic », un identifi: To use “Jibayatic”, a personal username and password are required. Taxpayers who do not yet have these codes must contact the competent tax services (tax inspectorates, tax centers or local tax centers).
Ce choix de banques publiques vise à str: This choice of public banks aims to structure the service within the national banking network before a possible extension to the private sector. It also guarantees the traceability of financial flows and the security of State revenue.
La DGI souligne deux objectifs principau: The DGI underlines two main objectives: to simplify the lives of citizens when it comes to taxes and to strengthen the efficiency of public revenue collection. This service is part of a global approach to improving the quality of public service.
